title: Principal coefficient sequences on arbitrary pro-etale sites
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l and a scheme X. Let pi be its uniformizer and let B be the inverse limit of the constant ring sheaves O_E/(pi^(m+1)), with projections p_n [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For every n>=0, the sequence of underlying additive sheaves B --pi^(n+1)--> B --p_n--> (O_E/(pi^(n+1)))_X is short exact. Multiplication is the terminal-section multiplication of [lem-pod-derived-reduction-sheaf-resolution-independence], using the actual constant-to-completion map.

proof.text: The constant-to-completion map commutes with restriction from the terminal object. Thus terminal-section multiplication is multiplication by the constant uniformizer power on every site object. The quotient projection kills it, by the defining principal ideal and naturality of the constant sheafification unit.
Completed uniformizer regularity makes the first map injective on every object. Completed projection divisibility identifies its image with the kernel of the second map.

A set-theoretic section of the quotient of coefficient rings becomes a section after constant set sheafification. Hence every quotient section lifts to the constant integer sheaf and then to the completed ring; the limit-lift projection identity proves surjectivity. Evaluation detects presheaf homology and monomorphisms/epimorphisms, so sectionwise short exactness gives short exactness of additive presheaves. The faithful additive sheaf inclusion reflects the short exact sequence. The same proof includes n=0 and the empty site.

theorem integral_principal_reduction_coefficients (X : Scheme.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (n : ℕ) :
    let U := ProEt.mk (𝟙 X)
    let O := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted.{u, u} l E X
    let μ := sectionMultiplication.{u + 1, u, u + 1} O U
      (MorphismProperty.Over.mkIdTerminal @WeaklyEtale X)
      ((integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses.{u, u} l E X).hom.app (op U)
        ((toSheafify (ProEt.topology X) ((Functor.const X.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
          (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))).app
            (op U) (ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E) ^ (n + 1))))
    let φ := (sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1} ⋙
        forget₂ RingCat.{u + 1} AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).map
      (completedIntegralCommRingProjectionUnrestricted.{u, u} l E X n)
    ∃ hz : μ ≫ φ = 0, (ShortComplex.mk μ φ hz).ShortExact
